name: Hercules Beetle
element: Earth (from the Goat); Capricorn adds Earth, cardinal

header_hanzi.verdict: NOT THE ANIMAL'S NAME. 甲 jiǎ means shell, carapace or armor (also the first heavenly stem); it does not mean beetle on its own. The Chinese name of Dynastes hercules is 長戟大兜蟲 cháng jǐ dà dōu chóng ('long-halberd great helmet beetle'; simplified 长戟大兜虫), also listed as 赫克力士長戟大兜蟲 hè kè lì shì cháng jǐ dà dōu chóng. If one short glyph is wanted, 甲 can stay only if labeled as 'armor', with pinyin jiǎ.

western.temperament: Hardworking, determined, responsible, practical, patient, loyal, reliable; dry, deadpan humor; good at spotting patterns; deep and wise with age. Shadow: stoic or stuffy, blunt or bossy, overworks and uses work to avoid personal problems, struggles with strong emotion, rigid standards, shuts people out.
western.modality: Cardinal; opposite sign Cancer; name means 'horned goat'; dates about 22 December to 20 January

chinese.temperament: Gentle, mild, sympathetic, kind, with a strong sense of justice; creative, persevering, inwardly tough and resilient, good defensive instincts. Shadow: shy and reserved, holds opinions firmly, private, few close friends, can be stubborn. 羊 yáng covers both goat and sheep.

symbolism.culture: Guadeloupe and Dominica (Lesser Antilles, where the nominate species lives)
symbolism.meaning: Locally called 'scieur de long', the sawyer, from a belief that it saws branches off trees with its horns. The cutting is really done by a longhorn beetle, Oncideres amputator. A strong bridge: an animal blamed for damage it never does, while its real fighting is lifting, not cutting.

Named after Hercules (Heracles), the hero famed for great strength. Wikipedia calls it 'known for its tremendous strength'; the name is the source of the strength reputation as much as any measurement.

Rhinoceros beetles are kabutomushi, 'samurai helmet insect'. Children hunt them in summer, beetle sumo tournaments draw crowds, and Hercules beetles (not on Japan's invasive-species ban list) feed a large import and smuggling trade; the Pokemon Mega-Heracross is based on it. Note the native kabutomushi is a different species; only the trade and the Heracross item are about D. hercules.
長戟大兜蟲 cháng jǐ dà dōu chóng: the thoracic horn is read as a 戟 jǐ, a halberd, and 兜 dōu is a helmet. A soldier's image, matching the Japanese 'helmet' name.

symbolism.culture: Classical Chinese (Goat half, the page's proverb)
symbolism.meaning: 羊質虎皮 yáng zhì hǔ pí comes from Yang Xiong's Fayan (法言, ch. 吾子): a goat in a tiger's skin 'sees grass and is pleased, sees a 豺 chái (dhole or jackal) and trembles, forgetting its skin is a tiger's'. Said of someone who copies Confucius's dress but not his substance.
Unsourced for this species, do not use. Scarab symbolism belongs to dung beetles, not to Dynastes; using it would be a borrowed-species error.

fusion.temperament: Our reading: double Earth, cardinal and yin. Capricorn builds toward a summit and counts the years it takes; the Goat wants solid, quiet ground and its own pace. The Hercules Beetle is that pairing made literal: a grub that spends one to two years or more inside one rotting log, then a short adult life spent carrying weight. Both halves are horned goats (Capricorn means 'horned goat'; 羊 yáng is goat), and the beetle is the horned one.
fusion.gifts: Our reading: patience that turns obscure years into real strength; force used to remove a problem rather than wound it (rivals are gripped between the horns and lifted off, per Wikipedia); a surface that honestly shows the weather (the elytra darken with humidity); steadiness others lean on.
fusion.shadow: Our reading: Capricorn's habit of measuring worth by load carried, plus the Goat's privacy, gives a beetle that hauls without asking for help and calls it strength. Also the sawyer problem: a fierce reputation that arrives before you do and that you never correct.
fusion.love: Our reading: shows love by carrying, rarely by saying. Slow to open (Goat shyness, Capricorn reserve), then loyal for the long haul. Needs a partner who notices the lifting and asks about the weight.
fusion.money: Our reading: a long-horizon saver; the larval years are an investment account. Risk: deferring all enjoyment to an adult season that turns out to be short.
fusion.conflict: Our reading: avoids fights until a branch is truly contested, then settles it decisively and without cruelty. Warns first (adults can make a huffing sound, per Wikipedia). Holds a grudge less than a Capricorn usually does, because the Goat wants peace back.

candidate_lines: Two years in one rotting log, eating the dark, and nobody came to check on you. The horn you carry now was paid for in that log.
When a rival climbs onto your branch, you clamp him between your two horns and lift him off. No blood. The Goat in you wants the branch back, nothing more.
Your shell goes from olive to nearly black when the air turns heavy. Anyone who calls you unreadable has never stood near you before the rain.
On Guadeloupe they blamed you for sawing branches off trees, work another beetle does. You still carry a reputation for damage you never caused.
The Capricorn half counts the months of building; the Goat half wants a soft, damp place to do it in. One sound log in a wet forest can hold you for years.
Your grown-up season is the short one, and you spend it hauling weight on the forest floor as if the log years had to be repaid in full.

fact_audit.note: 甲 jiǎ means shell, carapace, armor or 'first' (Wiktionary); not 'beetle' and not this species. Correct name: 長戟大兜蟲 cháng jǐ dà dōu chóng (BioSurveys lists 赫克力士長戟大兜蟲; tropicals.cn lists 长戟大兜虫). No pinyin is shown on the page.

fact_audit.fact: Strapline: 'The strongest beetle alive settles every fight by lifting, never by wounding'
fact_audit.note: No source names it the strongest beetle. The measured relative-strength record is the dung beetle Onthophagus taurus, 1,141 times its body weight (Knell and Simmons 2010). Wikipedia supports 'longest extant beetle' (up to about 173 to 175 mm with horns). 'Never by wounding' is unsourced; fights are described as grabbing, lifting and throwing.

fact_audit.fact: Intro: one of the largest beetles, damp understory of Central and South American rainforests; males carry two curved horns
fact_audit.note: Range southern Mexico to Bolivia (Wikipedia); understory of montane and tropical rainforest (ADW). Only males have horns (ADW).

fact_audit.fact: Larval stage 12 to 18 months in decaying wood; in horned beetles generally, larval nutrition shapes the adult horn
fact_audit.note: ADW gives 12 to 18 months (captive data); Wikipedia says up to two years; Karibiodiv gives 13 to 36 months on Guadeloupe. Say 'one to two years or more'. The nutrition-horn link is real but the cited study is on a dung beetle, Euoniticellus intermedius (Reaney and Knell 2015); the page's 'in horned beetles generally' hedge should name it as another species.

fact_audit.fact: Thoracic and cephalic horns work like a pincer to clasp a rival and lift him off, rather than pierce or kill
fact_audit.note: Wikipedia: males grab and pin the rival between the cephalic and thoracic horns 'to lift and throw them'. Karibiodiv calls the horns 'pincers'. ADW notes battles were observed only in artificial conditions. 'Rather than to kill' is an inference; drop it.

fact_audit.fact: Horn-closing muscle measured at 140 newtons (14.3 kg), from an insect weighing a few dozen grams at most
fact_audit.note: ADW states 140 N (14.3 kg) for the thoracic-horn muscle; ADW gives no primary citation, and I could not trace the original measurement. The adult body weight clause is unsourced; cut it.

fact_audit.fact: Elytra shift from yellow-olive in dry air to nearly black as moisture rises, via shell microstructure
fact_audit.note: ADW: yellow to olive green at low humidity, stark black with rising moisture, from microstructure changing light refraction. Wikipedia agrees.

fact_audit.fact: No predation event on an adult has ever been documented; researchers attribute this to armor, horns and mass
fact_audit.note: ADW: 'No predation events on D. hercules have been observed and documented', with possible predators of larvae (birds, bats, rats). ADW does not attribute this to armor, horns or mass; that explanation is unsourced. Also ADW says no events at all, not only on adults.

fact_audit.fact: Pupal stage 2 to 3 months; adult lives 8 to 12 months
fact_audit.note: ADW gives these figures (captive data). Wikipedia gives a pupal stage of about 32 days in the lab and adults living three to six months in captivity. Present as a range or drop the numbers.

fact_audit.fact: Proverb 羊質虎皮 yáng zhì hǔ pí: 'a goat wearing a tiger's skin still bolts at the sound of a wolf'
fact_audit.note: Fayan (Yang Xiong): 見豺而戰, it SEES a 豺 chái (dhole or jackal) and TREMBLES. Not a wolf, not a sound, not bolting. Meaning (show without substance) is right. Pairing with the Goat is labeled as ours, which is honest.

fact_audit.fact: Lunar New Year note: a Capricorn born in January or early February can belong to the Horse
fact_audit.note: Capricorn ends about 20 January and Lunar New Year never falls before about 21 January, so every January-born Capricorn belongs to the previous year animal. A Capricorn born in January 2015 is a Horse; a Goat-year Capricorn is born December 2015 or January 2016 (or Dec 2003/Jan 2004, Dec 1991/Jan 1992). 'Early February' does not apply. The 'recent Goat years 1991, 2003, 2015' line therefore misleads January Capricorns.
No star is assigned from the sign pair; the page says a chart is cast from lunar birth date and hour.
